result.summary: This narrow residential street features row houses with extremely limited sidewalk space. Parked vehicles frequently obstruct the narrow walkways, likely forcing pedestrians into the travel lane, and there is a complete lack of marked crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are extremely narrow and partially obstructed by parked vehicles, which may force pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Poor Sightlines
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow street limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalks to meet ADA standards and provide a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Restrict parking to one side of the street or remove it entirely to ensure sidewalks remain clear and accessible.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this narrow residential street.

result.summary: The environment is a narrow residential street or alleyway lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as a paved sidewalk or street lighting. Pedestrians are forced to navigate uneven, unpaved surfaces and share limited space with parked vehicles, creating a hostile walking environment.

hazards.name: Lack of paved sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no formal paved walkway, forcing pedestrians onto uneven dirt and broken pavement.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Parked vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: The parked SUV narrows the available travel space, potentially forcing pedestrians into the center of the narrow roadway.

hazards.name: Uneven walking surface
hazards.description: The ground is a mix of dirt, weeds, and degraded concrete, creating significant trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pavement Restoration
interventions.description: Repave the roadway to eliminate trip hazards and provide a predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with a sidewalk present only on the right side. The pedestrian environment is constrained by utility poles obstructing the walkway and a lack of formal crossing infrastructure or traffic calming.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are positioned in the center of the narrow sidewalk on the right, significantly reducing the clear walking width.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide safe pedestrian access on both sides.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the furniture zone or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or chicanes to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this narrow residential corridor.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential sidewalk with a paved surface in good condition. The environment is characterized by row houses and a fenced-off lot, providing a continuous but constrained walkway with no buffer from the adjacent roadway where parallel parking is present.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The parked vehicle in the foreground may obscure sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long green fence and concrete wall create a lack of active frontage, which can reduce the sense of security due to fewer 'eyes on the street'.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Incorporate a furniture zone or planting strip to provide physical separation between the walkway and the roadway.
